subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp timestamp coalescing be default behavior, an opt-in WhatsApp config, or deferred in favor of broader debounce policy work?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the choice affects user-visible latency, turn grouping, and the config contract for an integration-specific delivery quirk.

options.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
options.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped WhatsApp timestamp coalescing option with tests for same-timestamp text messages and no default behavior change.

options.title: Make coalescing default
options.body: Treat same-server-timestamp WhatsApp messages as one turn by default, accepting an upgrade-sensitive behavior change for current users.

options.title: Defer to broader debounce policy
options.body: Keep this open under a wider channel batching design so per-group debounce and media batching decisions are resolved together.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped WhatsApp timestamp coalescing option with tests for same-timestamp text messages and no default behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided maintainer-facing review on this issue and has adjacent shared debouncer/config/docs history, so they are the best available owner for the product/config choice.
